They went out at first light{c_p9_none/} with the chain and the
poles. The boy walked {c_p9_ahead ahead, testing the ground with a
|plants|willow|| switch, and where the switch sank he said {s_p9_cuidado}cuidado{s_p9_cuidado/}
without turning round. By noon they had fixed |numbers=46|forty-six||
stations and lost one boot. The wind brought salt, and
under the salt the smell of something older, as if the
|weather|sea|| had left its cellar door open.

That night she inked the {c_p7_sheet}first sheet{c_p7_sheet/}. She wrote Low
Harbor in the corner and under it, smaller, the date,
and then sat for a long while looking at the {m_p9_white}white part
of the paper, which was most of it!
